The '''Mark IV sentry droid''', also known as the '''IM4''', was a small, multi-purpose [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufactured by the [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]] and employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Mark_IV_Sentry_Droid_TofG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A Mark IV with [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]]]]
Fitting their purpose, Mark IV droids were equipped with an extensive sensor complement in place of traditional weaponry. The droid featured electromagnetic, infrared, and visible-light sensors, in addition to three hours worth of holorecording memory.<ref name="EGD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> They were capable of flying up to 10 meters in the air via built-in [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]].<ref name="NEGD" /> The droids constantly broadcasted a low-frequency transponder signal back to its headquarters so they would know if the droid was destroyed or captured.<ref name="EGD" />

Because of their powerful sensory equipment, Mark IV droids were used for a variety of tasks: battlefield reconnaissance, surveying, and sentry and patrol duties. The droids were even capable of long-range surveillance due to the inclusion of a holorecording rig. Although equipped with basic personality programming and self-preservation instincts, Mark IV droids were compelled to obey orders given to them, leading cautious [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] to scout dangerous terrain ahead with the essentially expendable droids.<ref name="EGD" />

==History==
Hundreds of Mark IV droids were deployed from the [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] to scout the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where they searched the crowded streets of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] in cooperation with [[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|sandtroopers]] searching for [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].

One such droid interrupted an [[ASP-series labor droid/Legends|ASP-series droid]] assembling what it thought to be an illegal antenna. The ASP droid responded by smashing the Mark IV.
